_notes: Commissary garages (design: Commissary and new foods). Keys starting with an underscore are notes; the loader ignores them.
_commissaries: Each is a garage in an industrial or mixed block, picked from tools/balance/city.json (9 October 2026): warehouses without a fixed business where the block has one, else a unit on the neighbourhood's edge street. id is lower-case letters, digits and dashes and is part of the commissary's phone contact (foodtrucks-commissary-<id>, which en.json names). name is a locale key. address is street#number. The loading bay is the kerb by the building's nearest entrance; a vehicle within rules.json's commissary.bayRadiusMetres of it stands in the bay. An optional bay {x, z} (world metres, as Ctrl+F8 logs them) moves the bay to a measured point, for a garage whose entrance faces a no-parking kerb. Positions are approximate until checked in game.
